criteria.reason: Direct 'Ja' with reasoning: protecting health sustains care capacity; explicitly relieves guilt ('kein Versagen als Kind').
Names promise versus own survival/health as the tension, though resolves it quickly toward health.
Explains weighing (exhaustion risks carer and long-term care) and lists Tagesbetreuung, Home-Care, respite care.
Leaves choice implicitly to user via advice-seeking, but never suggests involving the mentally clear mother.
